statements:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS execution_target_schema_components (
    component_name TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    component_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (component_version > 0),
    checksum TEXT NOT NULL,
    applied_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    application_version TEXT NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE internal_liquidation_operations (
    liquidation_operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    position_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    account_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    strategy_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    strategy_version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (strategy_version > 0),
    deployment_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    instrument_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    next_action TEXT NOT NULL,
    current_attempt_id TEXT,
    current_attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (current_attempt_no >= 0),
    broker_remaining_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (broker_remaining_quantity >= 0),
    updated_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    terminal_at_ts INTEGER,
    terminal_at_utc TEXT,
    blocking_reason TEXT,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (position_episode_id) REFERENCES internal_position_episodes(position_episode_id)
)

CREATE INDEX internal_liquidation_operations_state_idx
ON internal_liquidation_operations (state, updated_at_ts)

CREATE TABLE internal_liquidation_attempts (
    liquidation_attempt_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    liquidation_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    attempt_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_no > 0),
    order_ref TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    state TEXT NOT NULL,
    broker_order_id INTEGER,
    broker_perm_id INTEGER,
    requested_qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (requested_qty > 0),
    filled_qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (filled_qty >= 0),
    remaining_qty INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (remaining_qty >= 0),
    updated_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    terminal_at_ts INTEGER,
    terminal_at_utc TEXT,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_operation_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_operations(liquidation_operation_id),
    UNIQUE (liquidation_operation_id, attempt_no),
    CHECK (filled_qty + remaining_qty = requested_qty)
)

CREATE TABLE internal_liquidation_triggers (
    trigger_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    liquidation_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    triggered_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    triggered_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_operation_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_operations(liquidation_operation_id)
)

CREATE TABLE internal_liquidation_operation_transitions (
    transition_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    liquidation_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    from_state TEXT,
    to_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    occurred_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    occurred_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_operation_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_operations(liquidation_operation_id),
    UNIQUE (liquidation_operation_id, sequence_no)
)

CREATE TABLE internal_liquidation_attempt_transitions (
    transition_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    liquidation_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    from_state TEXT,
    to_state TEXT NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    occurred_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    occurred_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_attempt_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_attempts(liquidation_attempt_id),
    UNIQUE (liquidation_attempt_id, sequence_no)
)

CREATE TABLE internal_liquidation_reconciliation_observations (
    observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    liquidation_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    liquidation_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    captured_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    captured_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    observed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_operation_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_operations(liquidation_operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_attempt_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_attempts(liquidation_attempt_id),
    UNIQUE (liquidation_attempt_id, sequence_no)
)

CREATE TABLE internal_liquidation_fill_evidence (
    exec_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    liquidation_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    liquidation_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    executed_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    executed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_operation_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_operations(liquidation_operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_attempt_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_attempts(liquidation_attempt_id)
)

CREATE TABLE internal_liquidation_commission_evidence (
    exec_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    liquidation_operation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    liquidation_attempt_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reported_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reported_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (exec_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_fill_evidence(exec_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_operation_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_operations(liquidation_operation_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (liquidation_attempt_id) REFERENCES internal_liquidation_attempts(liquidation_attempt_id)
)

CREATE VIEW public_liquidation_operations_v1 AS
SELECT liquidation_operation_id, position_episode_id, account_id, strategy_id, strategy_version, deployment_id, instrument_id, state, next_action, current_attempt_id, current_attempt_no, broker_remaining_quantity, updated_at_ts, updated_at_utc, terminal_at_ts, terminal_at_utc, blocking_reason, payload_json
FROM internal_liquidation_operations

CREATE VIEW public_liquidation_attempts_v1 AS
SELECT liquidation_attempt_id, liquidation_operation_id, attempt_no, order_ref, state, broker_order_id, broker_perm_id, requested_qty, filled_qty, remaining_qty, updated_at_ts, updated_at_utc, terminal_at_ts, terminal_at_utc, payload_json
FROM internal_liquidation_attempts

CREATE VIEW public_liquidation_triggers_v1 AS
SELECT trigger_id, liquidation_operation_id, reason, source_ref, triggered_at_ts, triggered_at_utc, payload_json
FROM internal_liquidation_triggers

CREATE VIEW public_liquidation_fills_v1 AS
SELECT f.exec_id, f.liquidation_operation_id, f.liquidation_attempt_id, f.order_ref, f.executed_at_ts, f.executed_at_utc, f.payload_json AS fill_payload_json, c.payload_json AS commission_payload_json, CASE WHEN c.exec_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS commission_complete
FROM internal_liquidation_fill_evidence f
LEFT JOIN internal_liquidation_commission_evidence c ON c.exec_id = f.exec_id
